operations.name: drive_access_events
operations.description: Who accessed which Google Drive files and when, from the Google Workspace audit log. One row per event. By default it returns views, previews, downloads and apps reading file content on a person's behalf, for the last 30 days. Filter by time range, event names (comma separated), the person who acted, a file id, or a file owner (an email, or a shared drive name). exclude_actor leaves one person's own activity out. Fails rather than return a partial list if the range holds more events than one run can read; narrow the dates. The audit log lags real activity by a few minutes or more.

output.name: actor_email
output.description: The person who acted; empty for a system or unknown actor.

output.name: actor_kind
output.description: person, or the kind of non-person actor such as system.

output.name: app_name
output.description: The application that acted on the person's behalf, if any.

output.name: event
output.description: The audit event name, such as view, download or access_item_content.

output.name: doc_type
output.description: The kind of item, such as document, spreadsheet or pdf.

output.name: owner
output.description: The file's owner: a person's email or a shared drive name.

output.name: visibility
output.description: The file's sharing level when the event happened, such as private, shared_internally, shared_externally or people_with_link.
